question: Should CodexBar permanently add this local Share Stats card in both the status menu and Settings?
rationale: The patch is technically sound and well-proven, but VISION.md explicitly reserves new features, meaningful maintenance surface, and privacy-affecting behavior for maintainer sign-off.

options.title: Approve local sharing
options.body: Accept the privacy-first local image/text export in both proposed entry points as a permanent feature.

options.title: Narrow the surface
options.body: Keep the export implementation but approve only one entry point to reduce permanent menu and Settings complexity.

options.title: Decline the feature
options.body: Keep CodexBar focused on direct monitoring and do not add a dedicated sharing workflow.

recommendation.title: Approve local sharing
recommendation.body: Accept the privacy-first local image/text export in both proposed entry points as a permanent feature.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete owns the repository vision boundary and merged closely related menu and multi-account behavior.
